files.description: EHI export data dictionary — 62-page PDF generated from Excel containing the complete schema for the tab-separated export files. Lists 94 tables and 2,818 columns with TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, and DATA_TYPE. Covers patient demographics, clinical data, medications, labs, immunizations, dental, behavioral health, pregnancy/perinatal (CPSP), billing (HCFA 1500), insurance, visits, documents, communications, referrals, and administrative data. Created 2023-10-22 by Milton Allione.

HTML source of the EHI export documentation page. Describes the export as tab-separated files in AXEIUM's native record layout with separate handling for rich text documents and images. Contains HTML comments showing version history (v1-v3, Oct 2023) including deliberate removal of FHIR/C-CDA references.
